grittier alternative to nop where humanity lost so much it had changed in various ways balance of vengeance is a separate work of fiction from the greater sdverse not endorsed or officially affiliated with the core work all views situations characters and themes present in bov are fictitious and are not representative of any possible real counterparts or the authors views it tells a story from a perspective of an antivillain so canoncompliant violence instances of sapiophagy and heavy themes are present first previous next part ii part i location black bane united dominion supply station standardized terran time december 5th 2133 there was a certain fatalism to the whole affair even after the butchery on fahl and then shortly after silis grenelka was poised to be different deadly heardearned by the time the invasion campaign was formulated and announced we knew that yulpas rarely backed from a fight even more rarely left a window of incompetence open to exploit it would be a graveyard to many whispers echoed across ships and bases that taste of finality lingered on my tongue as i traced her shoulderblade it was like we knew we hadnt much time and raced to use it before it fully ran out i dont remember why me and mira decided to bunk together when we docked for precampaign resupply leave and training black bane was a seedier station than many clogged like a shipside toilet and smelling the same so even officers didnt enjoy the luxury of private quarters guess it was familiarity weve slept around before knew each others contours and buttons well enough to find them tolerable and then stayed holed up in that little capsule of room for the remainder of the leave venturing out only for obligatory briefings and training i never experienced anything like that stay in bed while a woman lays nuzzled into your side in the blankets flicking through the holostream channels to find some old preglassing media to watch when she learned ive seen so few she got fired up to have me see a bunch of them and i watched with half an eye but mostly just transfixed by her face studied it lit up by the glow her smile as shed laugh over some silly jokes that i didnt give a shit about the way shed noisily slurped protein noodles up from a cup then wed laze about enjoying the softness of the civiliangrade bedding traced each others scars telling true and not so true stories behind him she recorded vids for her family and played back their messages for me all the way from earth showed bits of arkhangelsk the giant factories that pumped out weapons for terran command in the pitch black of the polar night and reminisced how shed go fishing with her brothers or driving for firewood on days when electricity got cut that lightness of a serumborn like a feather it lifted me up too the stories let me imagine i was there it was the happiest single month in my life not even sazgas mocking remarks about pheromone stench and ape proclivities made me mad the station was cold and damp and held up by boogers and scotchtape but i was warm my head was occupied by mira by the question of whether shed like the knit fingerless mitts i bought from one of atrium sellers not well the usual thoughts i felt like a real person for once you know that its just biology mira asked one morning as she was wriggling into the uniform right before my eyes what is she twirled her index finger fangs glistening framed by a cynical little grin the small scar over her eye shifted as she squinted krakotl footspur all of this us how so i hooked a claw over the rim of her panties pulled a bit and let it snap back she slapped my hand bodies know it could be their last chance to ehmm procreate so our little sivkitworthy crotchbumping marathon is a desperate attempt at continuing the species before we kick the bucket in a grisly fashion i stretched feeling the cheap carpetlike fur beneath my soles as i once again slipped farther than the small mattress she could be such a negative nancy we wont die i grumbled surprisingly i even believed it why such confidence all of a sudden well were the main character of our stories and as far as ive got these dumb shows i tugged at her hips trying to set her down in my lap and enjoying the resistance of the hard muscle below soft skin nothing bad ever happens to them by the skin of their teeth i attempted to bite her shoulder but she wriggled out of it not keen on roughhousing just now seriously dril get ready i dont want a tally for being late location ghanith system wrissan domain space on approach to the prophets talon void station standardized terran time march 18th 2137 this fleeting embrace of a semiforgotten happiness dissipates with the overload driving me into the seat knocking breath out for a few seconds the executive shuttle takes a hard turn with its hull thrusters breaking the burn giving me the opportunity to glance into the slit of the porthole for a glimpse of the space station on approach the prophets talon void pack training facility oblong and dark against the glowing disk of ghanith the arxur colony world it does look like a chipped off claw shard of something old and malevolent a captured and hollowedout asteroid its pockmarked with weapon batteries and satellite dishes like barnacles but beneath them its hide is all rock and ice radiator strips fan out from both ends glittering in the light of the systems dim red star stretching almost a kilometer in length it appears frozen in space as the shuttle burns towards it yet i know it spins slowly but its no sebek or black bane with their gravity generators ancient even for arxur tastes for the past couple of centuries the station mainly produced raiders the cutthroat boarding teams that seized federation colony ships and passenger liners but now soldiers for the combined united dominion armada graduate from its halls i look back to my lap at the holopads still active screen an arxur snout stares back at me from the depths of a profile log scales black like tar slitted and cunning eyes a ruddy orange nose covered with a myriad of small cuts that healed over pink for an abidencealigned asset jazhif appears too thin the scales hugging the bones of his snout too tight usually betterment scions are the larger and bulkier arxur the result of selection and wealth in equal measure but he feels sharper then he should i trace the holophoto with a claw for once this target isnt up for recruitment no jazhif would have to go deposion assasination maybe though wetwork isnt really in my or sazhas purview not that it means much when director jones is changing the rules of our agreements the fly and not like we have anything to say about it anyway i massage the stump of my pinky finger trying to pry off the rising anger a week didnt pass after our return to phobos from that coth recruitment mission and the nasty woman is there pinging the terminal of my hotel room and plucking me out of a longawaited bath about two months ago we got an encrypted message from the prophets talon what its a large void station in wrissan space no not directly addressed to us came through terran command they bounced it in our court overall looks like someone doesnt like their management and would like she peered at my towelwrapped form and smiled even more hungrily than i remembered a change i expressed a worry that it could be a trap jones wasnt keeping us up to date with all the schemes milintel was cooking up but it didnt take a genius spook to figure where the wind was blowing as the battles for the krakot colonies were underway the climate in wriss heated more and more sabotage terrorism colonial cities going dark from lost power supply line disruptions cattle ships hijacked in the void pirated transmissions erupting in the battlecoms calling to denounce the prophetdescendant abductions bombings of betterment offices and chapels targeted killings the elusive arxur collective that had been hatched over the two years since my involuntary indictment into servicing the spooks took shape fast the prophets herald seemed to pointedly ignore the attacks while the voice of the united dominion condemned them with froth at the pundits mouths execution broadcasts that it ran showed unfamiliar arxur on the chopping block i shuddered all the same at first the collective nipped at the betterments heel but soon the probing nibbles turned into fullon bites so was i wrong to worry that the efforts of terras little game had become too visible and obvious and so the source of it could be traced back generalissimus meier it was said had personally assured prophetdescendant giznel that the terran protectorate was in no way involved in this spike of antibetterment activity even publicly pledged his assistance to abidence and other betterment offices while in reality me and sazha alone brought in more than a dozen of highranking to the cause including two betterment scions abidence at least for now seemed impenetrable then again me and sazha havent seen the full scope of all of milintels operations the stars willing maybe the mole we found were doing exactly what they were supposed to dig into that carcass in any case jones dismissed my concerns that betterment could finally be onto us and couldve used the station as a lure the security of terran communications she insisted was beyond arxur capabilities to breach them unhackable untraceable unless they have someone on the inside a human factor she smirked but imagine arxur roping a reallife human into the betterment theyd rather kill themselves than let apes to the party i had no arguments to counter that so we are here i swipe the photo away and return to the text trying to know whats waiting us jazhif seemed to have come from humble beginnings highblood but the vrisk bloodline was not as nearly as influential as for example sazhas they ran some sort of a store chain on wriss and a couple larger colonies merchant not warriors he barely passed the runt test got marked as a scion after leaving the prophets chapel outlived three more promising siblings then with familial protection joined the office of strife rooted in there for a decade clawing through the trenches of wrissan bureaucracy more often than not his superiors cleared the way for him by dying on terra that wouldve been suspicious but not unheard of in most hunters careers after all the fittest survives the strongest succeeds and so after decades this is where he landed senior hunteroverseer of the prophets talon overseer to the new generation of some of the best warriorhunters the united dominion would produce yet he leers into the cameras lens like a prisoner during his mugshot theres a tangible hostility emanating from the expression as much as the holophoto can carry theres a challenge there come and try to take whats mine it seems slightly familiar and i know why translated through differences in species ive seen the same quietly threatening expression in various mirrors now despite knowing that sazha and i are going to instigate a mutiny within this persons realm despite the ultimate sin of this murderlizard being an abidence supporter i feel a pang of sympathy for him after all we are about to take his lifes work maybe even his life how many beings in this galaxy wouldve wished to do the same to me not that theyre alive to tell by my side sazha lets out a pained hiss and my head snaps over to the adjacent gravseat to see her squirming the holopad on her lap is active and i glean the headline of a preloaded news article from the herald quickly translating the slashlike arxuri script 9 killed 8 wounded after a cowardly attack on the prophets chapel in argish city collective implicated abidence high inquisitor sotril vows retaliation the blood of traitors will stain our lips for a century she notices that ive turned my head and her nostrils flare in irritation somethings wrong wrong her claw taps on the holopads glass in accusation you can say so almost 20 fledgelings bystanders killed or harmed in yet another collective stint and i i her right hands claws squeeze the devices casing sazha may have shed her betterment skin before me before jones but how does the saying go you can take a girl out of the village but you cant take the village out of the girl yes same here much of sazhas self formed under betterment shes no defective shes an example of what arxur should be under the wise guidance of the prophetdescendant and his many councils reserved emotionally stunted a vessel of pentuprage her language is sarcastic quips and notsothinly veiled jabs and insults to see her like this isnt something i witness often the wet shine to her normally glasslike reddish eyes i was one of them she hisses again and it comes out more like shes choking on a particularly large ribbone when i was just that age i too would go to the chapel with the other fledgelings gossip play hurgilk to think that what are we doing even did they deserve it not not the hunters the blades of abidence but just some folk who dont know anything but the prophetdescendants words no but i pause shut my mouth right before i say something stupid and insulting to an arxur like cant make an omelette without breaking a few eggs you know that collateral is inevitable i say quietly dont hoist yourself by that guilt but how can i not were supposed to fight betterment for a better future how is killing some fledglings making the future better they are our best i can hear pain in her voice and i as i search in the recesses of my numb chest for an answer dont find one oh there are many platitudes i could serve but it all rings hollow especially now when in every dead wouldbe scion she sees her past self her friends her people failing to provide a satisfying answer i do the next best thing deflect speaking of who deserves what what of essil then i ask feeling blood flush to my face as the always simmering anger resurfaces for a moment didnt he deserve to live betterment abidence they sure didnt think so and killed him sazhas pupils round up as they dilate and her tongue lashes out between her lips before she can stop it the hurt from the jab apparent on her snout essil a year passed since i got that first message from senior hunter naskat one of the trusted ground force commanders whod earned their place against the humans and to whom ive handed off essil to grow as a leader sazha and i were at the united dominions acp armada concentration point established over colia working on bringing a prominent huntercaptain defector to the milintels fold when naskats message dropped into my pad wrapped in discreet terran code as arxur typically are he cut straight to the point no frills attached thought youd like to know hunterascendant essil is brought in by abidence inquisitor nuvuth on the case i will attempt to leverage influence i remember the cold sweat that ran down my back the knot of dread in my throat the frantic pulling at any sort of strings i had everything in reach to know more and help unfortunately essils battalion was posted to the krakotl farreach colony inatalas grace shortly after the united dominion took it and that distance devoured the time i could use to change something or so i deceive myself to think that i could three days later naskat sent the second message it was even shorter than the previous but between every word i could read the old arxurs reserved grief the execution commenced today i went to take a shower and turned all the taps on me and sazha were close almost like siblings in some things but even she especially she couldnt hear my moment of weakness i dug the ground afterwards there were no recordings i could get a hold of nothing no witness accounts perhaps it wasnt public naskat went silent as well perhaps fearful of our communications being interpreted a certain way essils teeth and claws as a traitor and preykin filth werent collected what became of his possessions did they throw away his mug his collection of trophies which i am sure had gotten bigger the jurassic park and lost world paperbacks his claws had shredded to mush from rereading i often wonder how essil had accepted his death he who tried to smile like a human who would try to eat a potato chip and then vomit he who was my friend it even came to me in dreams for a while a frantic attempt at snatching him from under the blade or at worse times i was the executioner that savored the terror that seized his scutecovered features after all even though the circumstances of his death remaining unknown it was his infatuation with terra with humans with me that mustve eventually got him stuck in the abidences maw no he didnt deserve it sazha rumbles out in a low almost infrasound tone teeth bared the words are heavy as they rise from her throat by the moment we had parted from crimson retribution by different promotions i felt she had developed a sort of begrudging maternal feelings from the runt i i just get carried away so many needless arxur deaths thats all i stretched my hand over the armrest to grab her by the nearest foreclaw and give it a reassuring squeeze hopefully this among other things will bring them to a stop sazha nods then her slit pupils settle on the discolored worndown poster plastered to the sloped ceiling of the shuttle above our heads i immediately recognized it from a few years ago as it was everywhere an impeccably groomed blond trooper in polished plate his fangs pearly and blueeyed gaze settled with a stern optimism on the horizon with the words hes fighting are you in bold script below her large head jerks in the direction of the poster scrutinizing it hrrff did you ever buy this dril the fervor of how do you terrans call it propaganda thought youd be someone like that i shrug as much as the seat permits me i guess not that id be this guy but that id fight for a better future yeah i pause noticing the leathery corners of sazhas lips pull into the beginning of a sardonic grin what think its funny the thought helped me pull through quite some shit in prison your prisons arent worth the name she hisses i scoff still trying to oneup everything i say or do after all these years sorry youd prefer i was fighting giant martian rats and cellmates for rations to the death like in yours the vibration of her chuckle carries through the adjacent seat even despite the shuttles docking sequence id pay to look at that before i can answer though the shuttles intercom comes alive with the scratchy voice of our pilot dorthak weve arrived initiating docking procedures need you out of the hatch in 7 intervals that was faster than expected i feel for the change in gravity as our transport had decelerated and then unlatch the seats straps drifting over to the farther end of the passenger compartment where our cargo is light vacuumgrade suits muledrones and of course a weapons locker sliding a finger against the muledrones head i watch the hexapedal robot awaken and magnetize to the floor then crawl over to the exit podium sazha slips into her orange vacsuit not without my help as i guide her tail into the puffedup fabric tube with that done i pluck the consul csm from its rack in the locker and magnetize this hybrid of a pistol and submachinegun to my hip the terran protectorate developed it as a atroxgrade sidearm capable of taking down a mazic or takkan in theory it means that it would make short work of thick arxur hides and scutes especially with these nice 12mm hollowpoints all tucked up in the extended magazines that i toss into the muledrones container thankfully the prophets talon hunterguards wouldnt object to us carrying guns on board its an exclusively arxur void station so wrissan rules apply that is taking a hunters weapons away is the same as declawing or defanging them on black bane or sebek or phobos ii it wasnt so because of us humans arxur typically dont go insane from ptsd dont get drunk out of their mind and fight and also prefer to use their tails teeth and claws to settle disputes speaking of that my arxur security detail huffs heavily as she first slings a dominionpatterned devourerse over her shoulder then reaches for another consul the bullpup rifle looks as large as she is its design taking advantage of the arxurs crazy arm strength yet despite having her claws on it sazha is definitely glum thats new usually the devourer makes her happy what i ask sensing her frustration the crocozoids suitedup thick tail gives a long loud swish across the rack and she studies the weapon again dont you think that we got too little firepower to take over the station no technically yes but were not supposed to bruteforce our way in no instead a contact from this brewing rebellion will facilitate the transfer of power with their bodies or something which is what i remind sazha of the contact as jones says this nychus insisted that the majority of the hunterneophytes and theres like two hundred of them are ready to back us up theres also about thirty of the hunterguards and trainers combined closing the ammo container sazha looks up from her drone thats not a big force to chew through not for armed hunterguards they can mow the neophytes down easily and also wheres the guarantee that the recruits would stick to their supposed promises whyd you think they wouldnt her jaws part in a creaselike sardonic grin as always when she thinks me an idiot theyre arxur im arxur i know arxur i know you too you follow the strongest i point out with a heavy straight blade at sazhas direction then slide it into a sheath on my other thigh in that case my authority and a nifty little tool courtesy of that milintel labs should allow me to interact with the stations systems even override some when time comes ill lock out the stations comms the armory and hold the fucker this jazhif at gunpoint or you or well dispense the weapons among the neophytes sazhas eyes squint as she digests these propositions once again ts feet first into hell just like we did during the planetary assaults with the baboons or scythes we dont make definite thorough plans whats the point when all plans go tits up when faced with the chaotic nature of reality besides its not the first time when we will improvise on the go thankfully for all the bettermentinstilled rigidity sazha has a quick and adaptable mind to pull the kind of offthecuff shit that we usually do what about the wrissan command fleets once we go mute they could send someone up from the colony to or or bring in a whole strikeforce to claim our hides given the timeframe weve been given for the operation jones says that it shouldnt be a problem at all her words not mine plus this station has pretty formidable defenses its a fucking flagship on its own wed hold out until help comes easier said then done of course ive never operated even a shuttle let alone a shit let alone a station especially not an arxurian one you trust that woman sazha spits foolish ah shes so snippy and judgemental the fire of loathing towards jones dances in her big bloodorange eyes and in this moment i truly love her who said i do i finally zip up the light vacsuit over my uniform and watch the airlock cycle the suits helmet tucked under my armpit the umbilical should be pressurized but in case something goes awry i can quickly put it on i know she doesnt give a single fuck about us but the mission oh she does shell ensure its success and thered be none if we die the temperature in the docking sleeve is low and our breathe comes in quickly crinkling puffs of gas as we float down the dimply lit tube down to the prophets talon sazha is habitually silent her tail is held stiff so as to not interfere with the microgravity drift the rifle clutched to her chest like a fresh hatchling as we pass a small porthole i cant help but take a potshot prophets talon everythings got to be prophets i sneer why not prophets dick the shape is close its the size thats way off the space lizard turns around gracefully in the tube instantly reminding me of the fact that the arxur ancestors were aquatic the tail remains immobile but the rest of the body twists fluidly as she reorients if i hadnt known her for more than ten years now id think that theres a look of pity stamped on her snout is there anything that a terrans life revolves around rather than dicks not around on i snicker to my own joke like a kid knowing full well that this would probably be the last thing to laugh about in a while

parking tips for cleveland monsters vs charlotte checkers at rocket arena cleveland 0105 hey all monsters vs checkers on jan 5th is going to be a fun game but downtown cleveland parking on a friday night for a 600 pm start is honestly a mess if you dont plan ahead especially since youre hitting rush hour traffic figured id share a quick rundown to save everyone some headache first and this is the real insider move check out prked its an app where locals rent out their private driveways or garage spots right next to the arena its usually way cheaper than the official lots and you skip 90 of the main traffic on the big streets getting in and out because youre on a side street short walk big savings and no gridlock for traditional parking youve got the two main attached garages the gateway east garage and the jack cleveland casino garage which offer about 3300 spots the gateway east garage is the most convenient because it has a climatecontrolled bridge right into the arena on level three event parking for monsters games starts around 10 but can climb fast a massive warning though the line to exit these attached garages after the game is legendary you will sit for 45 minutes trying to get out onto the freeway ramp if you go this route you must prebook on a site like spothero or parkwhiz to guarantee a spot the gateway east accepts passes starting three hours before the game a smarter move is to park a few blocks farther away for an easier exit good alternatives include the pnc garage on vincent avenue which locals love because the exit flow is much better and the huntington garage near east 9th and chester the tower city garage is another solid choice because it connects to the arena via an indoor walkway so you dont have to deal with the cold for really cheap parking you might find a surface lot way out on 1402 st clair ave ne for as little as 3 if you dont mind a solid 15 minute walk you can also prebook spots at places like the euclid prospect gateway garage you should aim to be parked and walking to the arena by 530 pm at the absolute latest but honestly arriving before 400 pm helps you find the cheaper spots and completely beat the initial wave of pregame congestion a huge warning on street parking downtown paid parking is enforced seven days a week until 1000 pm and traffic and parking restrictions kick in about two hours before the game which is around 400 pm for this one there are special event zones that change the rates near the stadiums if you do find a street spot read the signs five times or you will get a ticket no questions asked for absolute traffic avoidance the rta rapid transit is the best option you can park for free at many of the rta rail stations outside of downtown like puritaswest 150th st and ride the train right into tower city station for a 250 cash fare from tower city theres a sevenminute indoor walkway connection straight to the arena final cleveland rule put your junk in your trunk dont leave anything visible in your car to avoid breakins also remember the arena is cashless and there is no tailgating in the garages hope this helps everyone get to the game stressfree and on time go monsters

how jonathan bailey became hollywoods highest grossing star opinion piece by the times article is here archive link is here im not copyingpasting the full article in this post as its behind a paywall so i have to be careful but a few choice snippets the past 12 months have been one of the hottest years on record climate change apart the source may issue from hove east sussex and a stubblebedecked thirtysomething who potters about there swimming playing the clarinet and bonding with his niece for 2025 has been the year of the british actor turned global heartthrob jonathan bailey at 37 bailey how difficult not to refer to this ubiquitous popular culture presence as jonathan perhaps even jonny has been the breakaway sensation of the year the nature of his appeal is threefold first there is the vast genrespanning talent the second element fuelling baileys ascent to world domination has been his palpable goodness third and finally of course our hero is ridiculously attractive 5ft 11in of oldschool moviestar charisma the universal appeal of which weve not seen since george clooney swaggered into the collective consciousness in the mid1990s

introducing the ioniq 3 hyundais compact ev gamble to arrive in 2026 from apples first foldable phone to koreas first domestically developed fighter jet 2026 is poised to usher in a wave of groundbreaking products and services with farreaching implications for both consumers and the industry to mark the new year the korea joongang daily has compiled a list of landmark launches in the tech automobile and defense sectors ed the ev market may be losing some of its early momentum but if hyundais ioniq 3 arrives as planned in 2026 it could change the conversation in a big way positioned to eventually square off against anticipated entries like teslas muchdiscussed model 2 the volkswagen id2 and byds dolphin the ioniq 3 will be a strategic offering designed to meet the growing demand for smaller evs and built around a compelling blend of competitive pricing and everyday practicality particularly as demand for evs remains subdued this compact ev is expected to play a crucial role in boosting hyundais sales in europe a market the automaker must increasingly prioritize as the 15 percent auto tariff imposed by the donald trump administration is expected to squeeze margins in the united states related article hyundai unveils concept ev three in munich could it become the ioniq 3 gv80 9 hyundai motors three concept car is missing a traditional cluster but added widgets that people want to customize sarah chea the model was unveiled last september at iaa mobility in munich under the name concept three it sports a fivedoor coupelike silhouette and a unified pixelstyle led tail lamp that stretches across the back paired with a split glass hatch reminiscent of the toyota prius inside the ioniq 3 marks a clear departure from hyundais typical design introducing an interior layout that seems deliberately rethought rather than merely refined the digital instrument cluster is separated from a wide infotainment display while a teslalike tabletstyle central screen is a visual highlight still hyundai sticks with physical controls for the climate system its conscious deviation from the industrys accelerating shift toward alltouch interfaces hyundai motors three concept car which could potentially be the ioniq 3 which was unveiled at the iaa mobility 2025 in munich germany sarah chea while powertrain specifications and detailed performance figures have yet to be disclosed the ioniq 3 is expected to utilize a downsized version of hyundais egmp platform rather than adopting the 800volt electrical architecture used in the ioniq 5 and 6 the company has opted for a 400volt system prioritizing cost efficiency and accessibility over outright charging speed the ioniq 3 is expected to be offered with two battery options a 583 kilowatthour pack and a larger 814 kilowatthour unit under the europe wltp cycle these are projected to deliver ranges of roughly 260 miles to 365 miles a global launch is expected in the second quarter of 2026 with europe likely being the main target speculation is also growing that the model will not be for sale in the us market prices are expected to start in the high 30 million won 20800 range extending into the low 40 million won bracket by sarah chea cheasarahjoongangcokr

queerbaiting in st5 this here isnt just a message full of spite but also a genuine question that im trying to comprehend let me speak openly as a queer person who believed in byler to the end because of the beautiful symbolism i thought was setting them up for a romantic arc before i say anything else let me add that this is my favorite show anyway and despite feeling criminally queerbaited and hate crimed i loved the way it ended for almost everyone except for will and his sexuality arc here is my question how does an actor not anyone specific an actor who knows that they are in the biggest show on netflix knows that its a supposed show for outcasts knows about the popularity of the byler ship probably ships byler themselves judging by the reactions of the cast to byler scenes in table read for episode 4 and is aware of the political climate in the world or the us specifically doesnt come up to the duffer brothers and say hey so unless your goal is to queerbait we should announce publicly that byler will not be happening like genuinely am i the only one who thinks that it is kinda everyones job to speak up to two middleaged white guys about how they approach plots about worldwide oppressed minorities incorrectly again im not blaming anyone specifically or trying not to blame but i genuinely dont understand how has this happened im not upset that byler didnt happen sometimes our ships are wrong thats alright its just a show however im upset that we were led on purposefully and no one tried to speak up and say that its messed up to do this i feel like everyone on the cast should have done something anything about it im not saying they should have said meh your show is crap change it for the fans but i truly believe that saying to the ga that byler was not possible like creators of wednesday said that they will not be writing a lesbian ship was everyones job and not seeing a problem with this writing and attitudes towards queer ships in the show is messed up i honestly feel let down not only by the duffer brothers but by every person on the cast who read the finales script and thought that it was appropriate given the wellknown public expectation of byler happening let me know your thoughts i guess

opinion for 2026 theres a better way to be hopeful opinion guest essay for 2026 theres a better way to be hopeful published jan 1 2026 500 am et by david desteno dr desteno is a research psychologist who studies religious belief and practice credit daniel forero as we look ahead to the new year hope seems to be in short supply recent surveys have found that sizable majorities of americans believed the united states was on track to become economically weaker and more politically divided nearly 80 percent did not expect their childrens lives to be any better than theirs and more than half feared we would make little progress in dealing with major global challenges such as climate change over the next few decades this lack of hope is ominous hope drives us to improve our lives and the world around us when its extinguished despair and paralysis fill the gap making progress even less likely part of the problem i believe is that our modern conception of hope is flawed it practically invites hopelessness when the stakes are greatest in the modern view hoping for something implies that you think its achievable research psychologists characterize hope as a positive state in which you feel motivated to reach a goal because you believe you have agency in the world and can identify a clear pathway to that goal in a similar vein selfhelp gurus like tony robbins argue that hope is a start but that determined action requires certainty that you can achieve your goals if that sounds like a high bar for hope thats because when it comes to our most ambitious goals it is on our own none of us can solve the climate crisis or heal political divisions even when we come together in groups trying to change the world can seem nave and quixotic from the modern perspective the solution is obvious dial back your hopes to something manageable according to most psychologists aiming for a goal thats beyond your control like trying to save a loved one from a terminal illness or ensuring that the government adopts a specific policy isnt healthy its a false hope a hope that can open you to disappointment and despair while minimizing your hopes can protect your selfesteem and reduce stress both worthy goals of modern psychology it comes at a steep price as challenges become more difficult we shrink from them we seem to be witnessing that phenomenon today as a sense of gloom and why bother sets in among americans fortunately an alternative conception of hope exists one that throughout history has helped ward off despair and motivate action even in the face of seemingly insurmountable challenges its an idea the worlds spiritual traditions have championed for millenniums hope is a virtue to be practiced not an aspiration to be managed most of the worlds religions agree with modern science that its unwise to base hope on the belief that if we just work hard enough we can reach any goal the catholic theologian thomas aquinas cautioned that a feeling of hope that rests on trust in our own power is often misguided the view in buddhism is the same much of the world is beyond our ability to control thinking otherwise is an illusion that can lead to despair however for spiritual traditions the recognition of our inadequacy isnt a bug its a feature it doesnt reduce hope it redefines hope by freeing us from the burden of thinking that our goals are entirely our responsibility to achieve adopting this view means accepting that while effort is important being human comes with limitations here hope is a way to be its a norm or as aquinas put it a habitual movement toward the good hope compels you to pursue goals with urgency but without the fear that if your hopes arent realized youve failed as a rabbinic teaching from the mishna puts it its not your responsibility to finish the work of perfecting the world but you are not free to stop trying either there is ample evidence that this spiritual conception of hope makes it easier to persevere in the face of adversity research shows that the religious among us possess a greater sense of hope in the future not because religion attracts people who are optimistic in general but because the practice of faith gives rise to hope studies following tens of thousands of people for many years as they adopted or disavowed a faith showed that religion clearly boosted hope the more people engaged with their faith the more hopeful they felt about the future when they disengaged a greater sense of despair followed karl marx argued that religion is the opium of the people that it leads people to take their hands off the wheels of society in the expectation that god will cure all thats not the case people who make religion a part of their lives are not only more hopeful for a better future theyre also more actively engaged in bringing it about a 2019 pew research center report showed that the religiously engaged were more likely than their nonreligious peers to join community and charitable groups and be politically engaged religion at its best as rabbi angela buchdahl once told me serves as a constant reminder that life is not about any one of us were all part of something bigger the same is true for hope freeing hope from our egos frees us from despair to hope is to do good without expectation that we can make it so it is to resist the darkness daily whatever may come

the 30th anniversary of the beijing world conference on women the ups and downs of chinese womens rights and the evolution of the ccps women policy the 30th anniversary of the beijing world conference on women the ups and downs of chinese womens rights and the evolution of the ccps women policy written on the occasion of the 2025 global womens summit held in beijing from october 13 to 14 2025 the global womens summit cohosted by the chinese government and un women was held in beijing chinese president xi jinping delivered a speech and political leaders and renowned womens figures from around the world attended the summit the proposal and organization of this womens summit were to a great extent meant to commemorate and pay tribute to the world conference on women held in beijing 30 years ago in september 1995 the fourth world conference on women was held in beijing china at that time chinese leaders including president jiang zemin and premier li peng as well as un officials and dignitaries from various countries attended the event it was at this very conference that the then us first lady later secretary of state hillary clinton delivered her famous speech in which she declared the globally resonant feminist proclamation human rights are womens rights and womens rights are human rights that speech inspired womens movements around the world the 1995 beijing conference also produced the beijing declaration and the accompanying platform for action setting numerous goals and commitments for the advancement of women in china and across the world this conference had a profound impact on the development of womens causes both in china and globally the hosting of the 1995 beijing world conference on women was not a coincidence in the early 1990s china was trapped in domestic and international difficulties for various reasons the chinese government sought to break the impasse and win economic and diplomatic support including regaining recognition from the western countries that dominated the international order womens issues became an entry point for this effort the founding and development of the chinese communist party ccp and the peoples republic of china have always been closely tied to the womens cause as a longstanding leftist party the ccp has made womens liberation one of its fundamental goals and key agendas during the land revolution workers movements student movements the antijapanese war the civil war between the kuomintang and the ccp the united front work and international propaganda the ccp always used the banners of womens liberation opposition to the bondage and oppression of women and gender equality to gain support from women and progressive forcesan important reason for its rise and eventual victory early female leaders of the ccp such as cai chang xiang jingyu and he xiangning made great contributions to the partys growth and to the advancement of chinese women mao zedong the partys leader famously proclaimed that women hold up half the sky criticized patriarchal and clan oppression and promoted the cause of womens emancipation the very first law enacted after the founding of the peoples republic of china was the marriage law which guaranteed freedom of marriage and promoted gender equality although a series of political upheavals misgovernance and increasingly conservative policy shifts under the ccp later severely damaged womens rights and interests the historical legacy of womens liberation was nonetheless partially preserved this historical background became an important favorable condition for chinas successful bid to host the fourth world conference on women however in the 1990s china remained relatively poor its legal system was underdeveloped public security was unstable and womens rights were frequently violated the trafficking of women and children domestic violence against women rape and sexual harassment girls dropping out of school exploitation and bullying of female workers and suicides of rural women were all common phenomena in china at the time legal and social protections for women were insufficient and womens rights were in urgent need of improvement although china in the 1990s was poor and backward in terms of womens conditions and general living standards it was also more open and more eager to integrate into the world than it is today at that time the world was in the postcold war wave of globalization and china showed its sincerity by enacting the law on the protection of womens rights and interests as a result the united nations western countries and international human rights and feminist movements supported chinas hosting of the fourth world conference on women hoping through this opportunity to expand cooperation with both the chinese government and civil society on womens issues spread feminist ideas in china raise awareness of womens issues and promote both the advancement of womens rights in china and the global womens movement the 1995 beijing world conference on women was overall a success not only did hillary clinton deliver a remarkably progressive speech but burmese democracy leader aung san suu kyi also addressed the opening ceremony and beverly palesa ditsie a black lesbian activist from south africa gave a speech on lgbt rights it was evident that the chinese authorities worked hard to present an open and progressive image chinas organizational capacity and its declared commitment to advancing womens rights were recognized after this conference chinas international image improved and its relations with western countries also saw progress however in the thirty years since then the rights and status of women in china as well as the feminist movement have not advanced smoothly or continuously rather they have experienced twists and turns moving from progress to regression from 1995 to the early 21st century the chinese government indeed promoted several laws and policies aimed at protecting womens rights and publicly advocated for the protection of women and girls while tacitly allowing the development of some nongovernmental organizations focused on womens issues for example the government cracked down severely on the trafficking of women and children greatly reduced the number of girls dropping out of school strengthened the fight against crimes such as rape and saw an increase in organizations focusing on the rights of female workers with economic development womens average income and employment opportunities also increased womens safety rights and incomes improved noticeably at the same time however the chinese authorities remained vigilant and repressive toward nongovernmental feminist forces with strong political overtones and independence only organizations and activists without political or rightsbased agendasthose limited to improving womens economic educational or living conditionswere allowed to operate nevertheless before around 2010 due to economic growth improved living standards and a relatively relaxed political and media environment womens rights did see significant progress after that however womens rights and the feminist movement in china stagnated and gradually regressed around 2010 several highprofile domestic violence cases occurred in which women after suffering extreme abuse and finding no help killed their husbandsyet court rulings favored the male side marking a major setback for the antidomesticviolence agenda which is crucial within feminist advocacy around 2015 the chinese authorities launched a fierce crackdown on feminist organizations and activists several street activists and radical feminists were detained and multiple feminist groups were banned this further narrowed the space for independent feminist activism in china and marked the governments growing intolerance of radical feminist expression it is worth noting that china had already hosted a global womens summit in 2015 during which the authorities monopolization of womens issues and exclusion of independent feminist voices had already become apparent in 2017 and thereafter the global metoo movement swept across the world and reached china the authorities made no official comments and in practice adopted a negative and repressive stance toward the movement in cases such as the one where zhou xiaoxuanxian zi accused tv host zhu jun and others within the system the authorities suppressed online discussions and searches and female accusers and supporters were frequently silenced having their posts deleted and accounts banned the judiciary tended to rule in favor of male defendants while mainstream media in mainland china either ignored or kept silent on these cases progovernment influencers and conservative figures openly disparaged the metoo movement criticizing or even insulting the women who came forward in 2020 amid huge controversy the chinese government enacted the divorce coolingoff period law which undermined freedom of marriage and made it more difficult for women trapped in domestic violence or unhappy marriages to escape the 2021 little red mansion case in shanghai and the 2022 chained woman incident in feng county revealed that despite official claims of having eradicated the trafficking of women the reality was that trafficking and enslavement of women still existed particularly affecting poor rural and disabled women who remain vulnerable to deprivation of personal freedom and abuse meanwhile the number of women in chinas top leadership and official positions has decreased and they have become increasingly marginalized in the past china had several influential female leaders such as soong chingling jiang qing chen muhua and wu yi most of whom held substantial positions of real power in recent years their numbers have dwindled in the current chinese communist partys highest decisionmaking bodythe 24member politburo including its sevenmember standing committeethere are no women at all the highestranking woman in chinese politics today shen yiqin serves only as a state councilor focusing on womens and childrens affairs a rank slightly terms of violence authority and wealth women by contrast were sacrificed and subordinated their role shifted from being liberated to being disciplined in family work and society women were expected to serve the greater good for example during the mao era womens liberation was promoted in name but in reality women who sought divorce were often denied by the courts and some women were even semiforced inevitably suppress feminism and womens resistance and complaintsjust as conservative governments do around the world second the improvement of womens rights and the development of womens causes in china have entered a bottleneck stage the more progress is made the harder further progress becomes in earlier decades womens rights were extremely poor and crimes against women were overt and severesuch as the trafficking of women frequent rapes and girls being deprived of education at that time both the government and society shared broad consensus and strong motivation to combat such difficulty third maledominated antifeminist forces have been on the rise forming a counterforce that hinders further progress in womens rights the vigorous modern womens liberation movements while challenging traditional patriarchy and advancing gender equality have also provoked male discontent and backlash in issues ranging from domestic violence sexual harassment and marriage to genderbased competition for employment education and social resources when women unite to defend their rights and resist patriarchy many men instinctively react with hostility uniting instead to oppose feminism as chinas economy has slowed and social tensions have intensified in recent years gender conflicts have been further aggravated many men especially those from lower social strata who suffer oppression explicitly antifeminist rightwing populist upsurge this trend has weakened external pressure on china to improve human and womens rights and has simultaneously emboldened antifeminist tendencies 1995 when china was poor backward and eager for western and global approval the china of 2025 is far richer and more powerful and its rulers more selfconfident and autonomous they no longer feel compelled to please the west or integrate into the world and thus act more willfully and unscrupulously on womens issues in the eyes of chinas top leadership under xi jinping womens issues are part of the construction of socialism with chinese characteristics for a new era women are seen as screws in the machinery of nationbuildingserving the state society and family and contributing to the womens summit took place in beijing state media such as peoples daily simultaneously denounced grassroots feminism as infiltrated by foreign forces and destabilizing china this shows that the official current ruling elite to embellish its image and court international goodwill they commemorate its form while discarding its essence and in many specific respects even run counter to it times have where mountains become sacred from nepals annapurna to bhutans jomolhari yaksa trek the himalayas are not a single story but a vast collection of landscapes cultures and spiritual traditions shaped by snow stone and centuries of human movement among the many trekking experiences found in this incredible mountain range two stand out for their unique character and lasting impact the annapurna trek in nepal and the jomolhari yaksa trek in bhutan offer travelers the chance to explore two very different himalayan worlds one is lively diverse and culturally layered while the other is quiet sacred and carefully preserved experiencing both reveals how deeply the mountains influence life belief and identity across the region the annapurna trek nepals grand mosaic the annapurna region is widely regarded as one of the most varied trekking destinations in the world in a single journey trekkers encounter tropical valleys terraced hillsides alpine forests glacial rivers and high mountain deserts towering above it all is the annapurna massif home to annapurna i at 8091 meters the first mountain over 8000 meters ever climbed the sheer scale of the range creates an atmosphere of awe that follows trekkers from start to finish the trek often begins in the lower elevations near pokhara or besisahar where warm air carries the scent of earth and vegetation rice paddies waterfalls and traditional farmhouses define the early days of the journey as the trail ascends the climate changes gradually subtropical forests give way to oak and pine followed by expansive rhododendron forests that burst into color during spring higher still the land becomes rugged and stark revealing snowcovered peaks and windswept valleys depending on the route chosen the annapurna experience can take many forms the annapurna base camp trek leads directly into a natural amphitheater of towering peaks offering closeup views of annapurna south machapuchare and hiunchuli the ghorepani poon hill trek is a shorter but renowned trek for its sunrise views which bathe the mountains in golden light the annapurna circuit is the most extensive option circling the entire massif and crossing the high thorong la pass at 5416 meters reaching the pass before dawn surrounded by prayer flags and icy winds is a moment many trekkers describe as unforgettable one of the defining features of the annapurna region is its strong sense of community the trail passes through villages inhabited by the gurung magar thakali and manangi people each with their own traditions languages and architectural styles teahouse trekking allows visitors to stay in locally run lodges where meals are freshly prepared and hospitality is heartfelt evenings are often spent sharing stories with fellow trekkers over bowls of dal bhat or cups of hot tea creating a social atmosphere that feels both welcoming and rewarding cultural and spiritual elements are woven naturally into the annapurna journey stone mani walls carved with buddhist prayers line the trails prayer wheels spin beside mountain paths and monasteries sit quietly against dramatic backdrops the mountains are treated with reverence not as obstacles to be conquered but as sacred beings deserving of respect this perspective adds depth to the trek reminding travelers that they are walking through a living cultural landscape jomolhari yaksa trek bhutans sacred path in contrast to the busy trails of annapurna the jomolhari yaksa trek offers a sense of rare isolation and spiritual calm located in western bhutan near the tibetan border this trek leads into a country that measures success not by economic growth alone but by gross national happiness tourism in bhutan is carefully managed and trekking here requires the services of licensed guides and organized support this approach protects both the environment and the regions cultural heritage the journey usually begins near the ruins of drukgyel dzong an ancient fortress that once defended bhutan from invasions from the first steps the trail feels quiet and pristine pine forests stretch across the hillsides rivers run clear and cold and the air carries a deep sense of stillness as elevation increases the landscape opens into broad valleys where yaks graze freely beneath towering peaks the central focus of the trek is mount jomolhari rising to 7314 meters known as the bride of kangchenjunga jomolhari is considered sacred and believed to be the home of protective deities the mountain dominates the horizon with a commanding yet graceful presence campsites near its base offer spectacular views especially at sunrise when the snowcovered slopes glow softly against the morning sky the trail continues through the remote yaksa valley where nomadic herders live much as they have for generations life here follows the rhythm of the seasons and modern influences are minimal trekkers cross high passes such as bhonte la or nyile la each revealing sweeping panoramas of bhutans untouched wilderness on clear days the views extend toward the tibetan plateau adding a sense of vastness and remoteness unlike annapurna where teahouses provide nightly shelter the jomolhari yaksa trek is a fully supported camping trek a trained crew handles logistics prepares meals and sets up camp allowing trekkers to focus on the experience itself nights are spent in tents under skies filled with stars with little sound beyond the wind and distant bells of grazing yaks spirituality is an essential part of the jomolhari yaksa experience chortens monasteries and prayer flags are encountered throughout the trek each carrying deep symbolic meaning guides often share stories rooted in buddhist philosophy and local legend helping trekkers understand the spiritual relationship between the people and the land many travelers find that the quiet pace and sacred atmosphere encourage reflection making the trek as much an inner journey as a physical one two treks two himalayan worlds although both treks unfold in the himalayas they offer distinctly different experiences annapurna is an energetic and diverse destination making it ideal for those seeking solitude spiritual depth and a pristine natural environment it also appeals to trekkers who enjoy cultural interaction varied landscapes and a lively trail atmosphere jomolhari yaksa is serene and introspective making it ideal for those seeking solitude spiritual depth and a pristine natural environment physically annapurna offers a range of flexibility from moderate walks to challenging high passes jomolhari yaksa demands consistent endurance due to altitude remote conditions and campingbased travel culturally annapurna reflects nepals rich ethnic diversity while jomolhari yaksa presents a unified buddhist identity deeply rooted in bhutanese life a journey beyond the mountains trekking in the annapurna region is a journey through vibrant villages diverse climates and breathtaking mountain scenery that unfolds with every step trekking the jomolhari yaksa route is an immersion into a sacred landscape where silence carries meaning and mountains are revered as guardians for those who experience both the reward goes far beyond stunning views these treks reveal how different cultures respond to the same mountains shaping unique ways of life belief systems and values in the end annapurna and jomolhari do more than test physical strength they offer perspective connection and a deeper understanding of the himalayas as both a natural wonder and a spiritual homeland
